subject: prd/ecosystem-help
statement: If If a derivation surface is missing or unreadable (e.g. no wiki in a distributed repo), then the system shall present what the remaining surfaces yield and name the absent surface — never fabricate entries for it
intent: the catalog plus an explicit "not present on this install" note
fit_criterion: with a surface removed in a sandbox copy, output contains zero entries derived from it and names the absence
